tests.details: Requirement registry, implementation state, and certified baselines files verified in project tree.

tests.description: Memory Governor allocation and pressure tiers
tests.details: Class budget partition verified across 9 memory classes. Allocation rejections and pressure transitions validated under hard limits.

tests.description: Page serialization, checksum and corruption rejection
tests.details: CRC32 checksum mismatch correctly detected and rejected upon 1-byte mutation in page payload.

tests.description: Page cache LRU eviction and memory bounds
tests.details: LRU eviction cleanly purges unpinned dirty/clean pages within governor byte limit.

tests.description: WAL append, sync, and crash recovery replay
tests.details: Sequential append-only log with fsync durability and crash replay reconstitutes exact transaction state.

tests.description: Async I-O queue priority scheduling and execution
tests.details: Priority queue scheduling executes CRITICAL WAL and high-priority reads before bulk prefetch.

tests.description: Path traversal and integer overflow defenses
tests.details: Path traversal attempts (e.g. ../../etc/passwd) and Long arithmetic overflows rejected with GdbSecurityException.

tests.description: Anti-fake telemetry and UNSUPPORTED metric handling
tests.details: Kernel restricted metrics return TelemetryValue.Unsupported rather than synthetic mock numbers.

tests.description: Complete verification chain and certification issuance
tests.details: CertificationAuthority validates all 8 mandatory requirement evidence tokens before certificate generation.
